test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 6 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which is the modified form of the game Volleyball?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Beach Volleyball.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Beach volleyball is **a best-of-three set contest,** unlike indoor volleyball where matches can go on till five sets.
 
• The first two sets are played until one team reaches 21 points - as opposed to 25 in the indoor version for its first four sets - and the third and final deciding set, if required, is played to 15 points.
 
• Beach volleyball has similar rules for hitting as international volleyball.
 
• **The beach game was developed organically on the beach and one of the things that commonly happens is it's difficult to get enough players to play a game of traditional 6-on-6 in a beach setting**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Other Beach Games**:

 
 
• ​Tug of War
 
• Hunnyball
 
• Tidalball
 
• Gritz
 
• Quaddleball
 
• Spikeball
